name: Zipline
author: Elliot Moreau
description: Upload what Omarchy captures (the clipboard after Print, your latest recording) and any file to your Zipline server, then copy the link.

barWidget.description: Upload the clipboard (press Print first for a screenshot), a file or your latest recording to Zipline, and copy the last link again. Right-click uploads the clipboard.

schema.label: Recent links shown
schema.description: How many recent uploads the panel lists. Server URL and token live in ~/.config/omarchy-zipline/config, never in shell.json.
